journeySummary.Programme: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
journeySummary.Programme Type: Government cashless health assurance (not a cash grant)
journeySummary.Who May Apply / Eligibility Snapshot: First check beneficiary entitlement. Eligibility is database/state-rule based; people aged 70+ have a separate expanded route. Cancer treatment is package- and pre-authorisation-dependent.
journeySummary.Documents to Prepare: Aadhaar or other accepted government ID; ration/family ID or state-accepted family proof; Ayushman card if already generated; diagnosis, biopsy/pathology, treatment plan and hospital records.
journeySummary.Contact / Submission Point: 14555 / 1800-111-565; hospital Ayushman Mitra / PMAM desk; State Health Agency helpline.
journeySummary.Important Caveat: Cancer packages require clinical treatment-plan approval and pre-authorisation; pre-authorisation is mandatory for cancer packages. Check the exact package, provider empanelment and available cover. Not every cancer service is automatically covered.

researchRecords.Scheme/Fund: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojna (PMJAY)
researchRecords.What is the official programme name?: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
researchRecords.What are its abbreviations or alternativ: AB PM-JAY; PM-JAY; PMJAY; Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. Ayushman Vay Vandana is the 70+ expansion/card. ABHA is a separate health identifier, not proof of PM-JAY entitlement.
researchRecords.What type of programme is it?: Cancer-care subset of a government-funded cashless hospital assurance scheme. This record excludes non-cancer treatment benefits.
researchRecords.Which organization implements the progra: National Health Authority (NHA), State Health Agencies (SHAs), and empanelled hospitals; state trust, insurance or mixed implementation arrangements.
researchRecords.Who is the programme’s administrative ow: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India; NHA nationally and the respective SHA operationally.
researchRecords.Is the programme currently active, pause: Active according to official material retrieved on 31 October 2026. Individual hospital/package availability must be checked live.
researchRecords.Which states, districts, or areas does i:
It operates pan-India, providing health coverage across empanelled public and private hospitals all over the country. 

Due to nationwide portability, eligible beneficiaries can access cashless treatment at any empanelled hospital regardless of their home state. 

Empanelled hospitals include all government hospitals as well as selected private hospitals across India
researchRecords.Which hospitals or institutions particip:
How to find empanelled hospitals - https://hospitals.pmjay.gov.in/Search/empnlWorkFlow.htm?actionFlag=ViewRegisteredHosptlsNew 

Enter details such as - State, District, Hospital type, Speciality, Hopsital Name, Empanelment type (PMJAY, CGHS, CAPF), then search.
researchRecords.When do applications open and close?: No annual competitive application window. Eligible beneficiaries can seek identification/card generation throughout the year; treatment authorization is episode-specific.
researchRecords.Are funds available or are there intake: Availability depends on verified entitlement, remaining annual cover, approved package and a participating provider. No nationwide intake freeze found; local restrictions require SHA confirmation.
researchRecords.What cancer diagnosis or medical criteri: Cancer only: medical oncology, surgical oncology, radiation oncology and applicable palliative medicine packages. Eligibility for each drug, regimen, procedure and care setting must be confirmed against the current state-adopted package master. A cancer diagnosis alone does not establish scheme entitlement.
researchRecords.What age or demographic requirements app: Standard eligible families: no family-size, age or gender cap. Separate expansion: Indian citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income; age is determined using Aadhaar.
researchRecords.What residence or citizenship requiremen:
1. Rural Beneficiaries
For rural areas, eligibility under AB PM-JAY is determined based on the deprivation criteria specified in the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC), 2011. Eligible households include those falling under one or more of the following six criteria:

D1: Households having only one room with kucha walls and kucha roof;
D2: Households having no adult member between 16 and 59 years of age;
D3: Female-headed households having no adult male member between 16 and 59 years of age;
D4: Households having a disabled member and no able-bodied adult member;
D5: Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe households; and
D7: Landless households deriving a major part of their income from manual casual labour

2. Urban Beneficiaries
For urban areas, the following 11 occupational categories of workers are eligible for the scheme:

Ragpicker
Beggar
Domestic worker
Street vendor/ Cobbler/hawker / other service provider working on streets
Construction worker/ Plumber/ Mason/ Labour/ Painter/ Welder/ Security guard/ Coolie and other head-load worker
Sweeper/ Sanitation worker/ Mali
Home-based worker/ Artisan/ Handicrafts worker/ Tailor
Transport worker/ Driver/ Conductor/ Helper to drivers and conductors/ Cart puller/ Rickshaw puller
Shop worker/ Assistant/ Peon in small establishment/ Helper/Delivery assistant / Attendant/ Waiter
Electrician/ Mechanic/ Assembler/ Repair worker
Washer-man/ Chowkidar

3. Additional beneficiary categories covered through specific initiatives

Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) and their dependants;
Road accident victims covered under PM-RAHAT;
Transgender persons covered under the Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE) initiative;
Eligible children under the PM CARES for Children Scheme who lost both parents, a surviving parent, a legal guardian, or adoptive parents due to the COVID-19 pandemic;
Waste pickers and identified sanitation workers covered under the National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) Scheme; and
Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) covered under the Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM-JANMAN).
researchRecords.What income or socioeconomic criteria ap: A low-income certificate alone does not guarantee inclusion. No income ceiling for the 70+ route.
researchRecords.How do insurance or existing benefits af: For 70+ beneficiaries, private insurance and ESIC do not exclude eligibility. CGHS and other specified government-scheme beneficiaries must choose the applicable scheme; NHA says surrender/choice is irreversible. Verify coordination with the SHA before opting. Do not automatically apply these senior-specific rules to every beneficiary group.
researchRecords.What other eligibility exclusions apply?: No eligible database match, failed verification, or failure to meet an approved expansion route can prevent access. Non-covered services and non-empanelled treatment are not automatically payable. Do not use old general SECC exclusion lists to reject a 70+ applicant.
researchRecords.Which expenses or services are eligible: Cancer-only scope: approved cancer surgery, systemic therapy/chemotherapy, radiotherapy and applicable palliative care packages, including the package-linked diagnostics, medicines, consumables, necessary implants, ward/ICU care, patient food and complications. Related pre/post care is up to 3/15 days. Standalone screening, routine OPD, every targeted/immunotherapy drug, travel, caregiver wages and independent supportive purchases must not be assumed covered.
researchRecords.What is the maximum financial assistance: National baseline: up to INR 500,000 per eligible family per year, shared across members. Existing PM-JAY families with 70+ members receive an additional INR 500,000 reserved for those seniors. Other 70+ families share INR 500,000 annually among eligible seniors. State enhancements are separate. This is the overall family entitlement, shared with other covered care; there is no separately guaranteed INR 500,000 cancer fund.
researchRecords.What percentage is covered and what co-p: Covered approved package is cashless with no beneficiary co-payment within applicable entitlement. Package tariffs, not an unrestricted percentage of any hospital bill, determine payment. Non-covered expenses are not automatically covered.
researchRecords.How often or how many times can assistan: Multiple approved episodes/cycles can be covered within remaining annual entitlement and package rules. No universal fixed lifetime number of claims. Confirm repeat-cycle, interval and annual-reset rules with hospital/SHA.
researchRecords.How are payments made and to whom?: Implementing payer pays the empanelled provider through the claims system. No INR 500,000 deposit to the patient; routine patient reimbursement for privately paid bills is not the standard route.
researchRecords.Can this support be combined with other: State convergence/top-ups may apply. Ask the SHA and other funder before combining assistance, and allocate distinct uncovered costs; do not claim the same expense twice. Senior government-scheme choice rules require particular care.
researchRecords.Which identity documents are required?: Existing Ayushman card/beneficiary identifier if available; accepted government identity for standard verification. Aadhaar and Aadhaar e-KYC are mandatory for the 70+ route; NHA states Aadhaar is the only enrolment document for that route.
researchRecords.Which residence and income documents are: Standard route: ration/family card or other approved family-link/database evidence as requested; state-specific expansion may require additional residence/income evidence. No universal national income-certificate rule. For 70+ enrolment NHA specifies Aadhaar only.
researchRecords.Which medical records and treatment esti: Oncologist clinical notes and diagnosis; pathology/cytology where indicated; staging/imaging and relevant laboratory reports; proposed surgery, drug/regimen with cycles, radiation plan or palliative plan; prior-treatment history and package-specific evidence. Hospital confirms exact requirements. Do not mandate biopsy for every presentation or assume all tests are separately reimbursable.
researchRecords.Which hospital or referral documents are:
To enrol of PMJAY, the following documents are needed - 
Identity & Age Proof: Aadhaar Card (preferred for e-KYC and biometric verification), PAN Card, Voter ID, or Driver's License
Family / Relationship Proof: Ration Card, family ID (such as Parivar Pehchan Patra where applicable), PM/CM letter, or Building and Other Construction Workers (BoCW) certificate
Contact Details: A registered mobile number for OTP verification
Category / State Documents: Caste or income certificates (where specifically requested by State Health Agencies)

Once you have PM-JAY, it is completely cashless and paperless government health insurance scheme, meaning no bank account or payment documents are mandatory to register for or receive treatment under the scheme. Treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals is entirely cashless up to ₹5 lakh per family per year, so direct hospital bill payments from your bank account are not required. Some partner banks (such as Kotak811 or HDFC Bank) mention linking a zero-balance or savings account optionally to manage ancillary or out-of-pocket expenses, but it is not a requirement to get your Ayushman card.
researchRecords.Which banking or payment documents are r: Patient bank details, cancelled cheque and bank passbook are not standard requirements for cashless hospital settlement. Hospital banking/claim requirements are handled by the provider.
researchRecords.What officially accepted alternatives ex: For standard beneficiaries, approved non-Aadhaar government ID and assisted BIS verification may be available; confirm current SHA rules. For the 70+ route, no Aadhaar substitute is established in the NHA FAQ; resolve missing/incorrect Aadhaar with authorized support.
researchRecords.Who is authorized to submit an applicati: Beneficiary or caregiver can initiate assisted identification/card generation. Authorized operators/PMAM perform system verification; the treating empanelled hospital submits treatment authorization and claims. An NGO does not acquire approval powers by referring a patient.
researchRecords.What are the exact steps to apply?: 1 Verify beneficiary entitlement and card/e-KYC. 2 Find an empanelled hospital approved for the required oncology specialty. 3 Oncologist prepares diagnosis, stage and treatment plan. 4 PMAM confirms package, remaining balance and authorization requirements. 5 Hospital submits oncology approval/queries before planned treatment. 6 Obtain approved treatment. 7 Track subsequent cycles/modalities, discharge medicines and follow-up.
researchRecords.Where and how must the application be su: Card/eligibility: https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in or Ayushman App, with assisted channels where available. Treatment: empanelled hospital PM-JAY desk via hospital transaction system. This is not a patient submission of an NGO funding proposal.
researchRecords.What must the hospital social worker do?: Recommended navigation role: connect with PMAM, help verify documents and family linkage, coordinate oncologist/package documentation, track authorization queries, explain uncovered costs and discharge entitlements, and escalate denial. These are suggested workflow duties, not a separate nationally mandated social-worker approval role.
researchRecords.What NGO referral or authorization restr: No compulsory NGO sponsorship/nomination found. NGOs may assist with consent, but cannot guarantee entitlement, approve treatment or charge an unofficial enrolment fee.
researchRecords.Where are the official forms and applica: Beneficiary portal: https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in ; NHA information: https://nha.gov.in ; PM-JAY: https://pmjay.gov.in . Hospital preauthorization is submitted in the authorized hospital system, not a universal public paper grant form.
researchRecords.What are the submission deadlines?: No nationwide annual application closing date identified. Obtain required authorization before planned covered treatment; respond promptly to hospital queries. Package-specific emergency and claim deadlines must be checked locally.
researchRecords.What is the expected processing time and: Card processing varies with authentication and record matching; no universal card turnaround verified. Historical hospital process guidance gives up to 6 hours for required preauthorization, with auto-approved packages; confirm current state SLA. Annual benefit and episode authorization are separate from card validity. For cancer, do not promise completion of authorization or treatment within six hours; the historical SLA is not a clinical scheduling guarantee.
researchRecords.What are the review and approval stages?: Beneficiary search → identity/e-KYC and family linkage → entitlement/card validation → clinical assessment and package selection → balance/document checks → authorization or query/rejection → treatment → discharge and hospital claim review.
researchRecords.Who makes the final approval decision?: Designated SHA/trust or insurer/authorized medical reviewer under the state implementation model; some packages auto-approve. Card identity approval and treatment/claim approval are separate decisions; social workers and NGOs are not final sanctioning authorities.
researchRecords.What are the rejection reasons and appea: Possible causes: unmatched eligibility, identity discrepancies, missing clinical evidence, non-covered package/provider or insufficient balance. Ask for recorded reason; correct errors through PMAM/SHA. Challenge denial or charges through 14555/CGRMS and district/state/national grievance mechanisms.
researchRecords.What are the official programme contact: National beneficiary helpline: 14555; alternate 1800-111-565 listed by NHA support. Official information: https://nha.gov.in and https://pmjay.gov.in . Verify any state-specific contact before use.
researchRecords.What are the hospital assistance desk co: Ask the chosen hospital for its Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra (PMAM)/Ayushman desk. Hospital-specific number cannot be completed without a named facility; obtain via hospital switchboard or 14555.
researchRecords.What NGO contacts and communication rest: Not applicable as a mandatory programme contact. No designated NGO contact verified. Share medical records only with authorized persons and consent; avoid unofficial agents promising guaranteed cards or sanctions.
researchRecords.What are the escalation or grievance cha: Call 14555; use CGRMS via the official PM-JAY grievance link, including https://cgrms.pmjay.gov.in ; approach hospital PMAM and district/SHA grievance officers. District, state and national grievance committees provide escalation. Keep complaint reference and supporting records.
researchRecords.What must the patient prepare before app: Identity/card and family-link evidence as applicable; phone access; oncology reports and treatment plan; current hospital/package confirmation. Seniors should check Aadhaar age and e-KYC readiness. Do not prepare bank documents or pay an agent merely to receive the national cover.
researchRecords.What are the application status mileston: Suggested tracking milestones: eligibility located; verification pending/completed; card generated; hospital/package selected; preauthorization submitted/queried/approved/rejected; treatment started; discharge completed; grievance open/resolved. These are workflow labels, not a verified universal portal status vocabulary.
researchRecords.What follow-up actions and reminders are: Before each cancer cycle or change of modality, confirm package authorization and remaining family balance. Track tests and hospital queries; retain treatment/authorization and discharge records; confirm covered post-discharge medicines and follow-up. Ask the hospital how care spanning the annual reset is handled.
researchRecords.What common obstacles occur and how can: Database mismatch: request assisted lookup/correction. Authentication failure: seek authorized alternative method/support as permitted. No oncology package/bed: locate another empanelled provider. Delay or demand for covered payment: retain evidence and escalate. Exhausted cover: discuss state top-ups or other assistance.
researchRecords.In which languages is official guidance: Official English and Hindi materials verified. Additional state-language resources vary; a complete current national language list was not established.
researchRecords.What translation or voice-support consid: Use 14555 and local PMAM support; request the preferred language and an interpreter when available. Read consent and benefit information aloud if needed. Do not assume every helpline or portal supports every Indian language.
researchRecords.Can patients access help offline or with: Yes: empanelled hospital PMAM desks, Common Service Centres and state/district assistance channels support beneficiaries. Staff can assist digital steps; a personal smartphone is not the only access route.
researchRecords.What primary source documents and URLs s: Sources: A https://www.rmlh.mohfw.gov.in/index1.aspx?langid=1&lev=2&lid=3619&lsid=2566 ; B https://nha.gov.in/img/resources/English_FAQs_related_to_the_benefits_for_senior_citizens.pdf ; C https://www.myscheme.gov.in/hi/schemes/ab-pmjay ; D https://nha.gov.in/img/resources/HBP-2.2-manual.pdf ; E https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3169779d3852b32ce8b1a1724dbf5217d/uploads/2022/05/2022051041.pdf ; F https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2116209&lang=1&reg=3 ; G https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2119281&lang=2&reg=48 ; H https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/nha/NHA-data-privacy-policy.html ; I https://supportbeta.nha.gov.in/ ; J https://www.pib.gov.in/PressNoteDetails.aspx?ModuleId=3&NoteId=160081&lang=3&reg=3 ; K https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2110384&lang=2&reg=48 ; L https://shamanipur.mn.gov.in/Static/FAQ .
researchRecords.Which exact pages or clauses support key: A Benefit Cover: annual family cover/components. B FAQs 1,3–10: senior age/e-KYC; 11–18: income, sharing, top-up, other insurance and choice. E steps 2,7,9–10: identity, authorization and discharge. C Application Process/Eligibility: database verification. F grievance paragraphs: escalation. G opening paragraph: Delhi adoption. D oncology sections: clinical/package checks (historical manual; current state version required). H consent/privacy provisions. K cancer specialties. Exact current state oncology clauses remain unverified. Historical HBP 2.2 sections 3.9 Medical Oncology, 3.23 Radiation Oncology and 3.24 Surgical Oncology address clinical treatment approval, prior authorization and multidisciplinary planning; verify section numbering and replacement circulars against the current adopted version.
researchRecords.When was the policy published and when d: National launch: 23 September 2018. Universal 70+ expansion launched 29 October 2024. Policies, packages and state adoption have separate effective dates; no single date governs all fields. Confirm the applicable state/package circular before clinical routing.
researchRecords.When was this information last verified: Official web-source review: 31 October 2026, by ChatGPT (automated desk research); not reviewed by NHA, a SHA, or a hospital officer.
researchRecords.What is the verification status of this: PARTIALLY VERIFIED — PM-JAY's ₹5 lakh family cover and 3-day pre/15-day post-hospitalization are supported by NHA official material. Cancer package scope and exact current package counts must be checked against the latest HBP master; do not rely on third-party package counts.
researchRecords.Are there conflicting or superseded sour: Older FAQs describing SECC alone omit later expansions. Older statements that Delhi/Odisha do not participate are superseded by subsequent adoption. Historic non-Aadhaar rules must not override mandatory 70+ e-KYC. HBP 2.2 is a historical reference, not proof of the current package master.
researchRecords.What is the record version and change hi: Version 1.1, 31 October 2026: narrowed the supplied 65-question record to cancer patients and oncology treatment; general entitlement rules retained. Proposed ID and workflow labels are editorial additions.
researchRecords.Which structured eligibility-rule defini: Suggested tri-state logic: beneficiary_eligible = verified_approved_database_match OR verified_approved_expansion_route (including 70+ Aadhaar/e-KYC). treatment_eligible = beneficiary_eligible AND active_empanelment AND approved_package AND clinical_criteria AND available_entitlement AND required_authorization. Missing inputs return UNKNOWN/manual review. Do not hard-code income alone or assume every drug is covered.
researchRecords.What privacy or consent requirements app: Follow NHA privacy and authorized e-KYC/clinical-system consent requirements. Explain purpose and authorized sharing; use guardian/representative process where applicable. Navigation-system recommendation: collect only needed data, restrict access, obtain consent for NGO sharing, and avoid storing Aadhaar copies/OTP/biometrics unnecessarily.
researchRecords.Who is responsible for editing and when: Suggested owner: your scheme-database editor, with SHA/PMAM review for operational fields; no person assigned. Proposed next review: 30 November 2026, or sooner after eligibility/package/state changes. This review cadence is editorial, not a government requirement.
researchRecords.Is pre-approval required before treatmen: Cancer-care approval is essential: historical NHA HBP 2.2 oncology guidance requires prior authorization at each step and a clinical treatment approval process; multidisciplinary tumour-board planning is advised. Confirm the current state/package rules and emergency exceptions with PMAM before starting a planned modality or cycle. The patient should not pay privately expecting automatic reimbursement.
researchRecords.Are there treatment-stage, diagnosis-sta: Cancer stage, indication, regimen, cycle interval, repeat-treatment and prior-treatment evidence are package-specific. No general pre-existing-disease waiting period. Related pre/post cover is up to 3/15 days. Do not treat all lifelong follow-up or all past bills as covered; verify relapse, recurrence, modality changes and care spanning benefit years individually.
researchRecords.What proof of application submission or: Ayushman card/beneficiary ID after successful identification; hospital transaction and preauthorization reference for treatment, with system/SMS notifications where generated. Obtain discharge records and any grievance acknowledgment. No universal paper grant-application receipt established.
researchRecords.What is the procedure when the scheme or: A general NGO intake closure does not close PM-JAY entitlement. If a hospital cannot provide care, seek another suitable empanelled provider and SHA help. If a portal fails, use assisted channels/14555. If cover is exhausted or treatment excluded, request documented alternatives; do not promise a waitlist or future reimbursement.

legacyRecords.Name of the insurance: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojna (PMJAY)
legacyRecords.Eligibility:
Rural Families: Based on SECC-2011 data; covers deprived households (e.g., single-room kutcha houses, no adult aged 16–59, SC/ST, landless casual labor) and automatically included groups (homeless, destitutes, manual scavengers).

Urban Families: Covers 11 informal worker categories (e.g., ragpickers, domestic workers, street vendors, construction workers, drivers, sanitation workers).

Senior Citizens (Aged 70+): Universal coverage regardless of income, providing a ₹5 lakh cover (a top-up for existing PM-JAY families or a fresh cover for others).
legacyRecords.Cancer types covered:
It covers cancer care including chemotherapy and surgical oncology under its standard oncology packages. Details of specific cancers is not provided.

Under Health Benefit Package 2.1, oncology care is structured across three dedicated specialties, comprising 166 packages and 435 procedures:

1. Medical Oncology - Specialty Code - 'MO'
    72 packages covering 264 procedures. Includes chemotherapy cycles, medical management, and day-care procedures. 

2. Radiation Oncology - Specialty Code: 'MR'
   14 packages covering 46 procedures.
   Covers radiotherapy treatments and radiation delivery packages.

3. Surgical Oncology - Specialty Code - 'SC'
   80 packages covering 125 procedures.
   Covers surgical procedures and tumor resections.
legacyRecords.Benefit cover:
Eligible families receive a cashless and paperless cover of ₹5 lakh per year for secondary and tertiary inpatient hospitalisation expenses across empanelled public and private hospitals nationwide.

The benefit spans approximately 1,929 medical procedures across 27 specialty areas—including ICU care, surgeries, diagnostics, and medicines—with pre-existing diseases covered from Day 1, alongside 3 days of pre-hospitalisation and 15 days of post-hospitalisation care. 

Additionally, all senior citizens aged 70 and above get a dedicated ₹5 lakh annual cover (as an exclusive top-up for existing PM-JAY families or a fresh cover for others), whereas outpatient care (OPD), cosmetic surgery, and drug rehabilitation are excluded.
legacyRecords.Location/State covered:
It operates pan-India, providing health coverage across empanelled public and private hospitals all over the country. 

Due to nationwide portability, eligible beneficiaries can access cashless treatment at any empanelled hospital regardless of their home state. 

Empanelled hospitals include all government hospitals as well as selected private hospitals across India
legacyRecords.Exceptions: Key Exclusions: Owning a 2/3/4-wheeler, government employment, monthly income over ₹10,000, owning 5+ acres of land, or owning a refrigerator/pucca house.
legacyRecords.Is radiation oncology covered?: Radiation Oncology is listed as an official specialty (Specialty Code: MR) under Health Benefit Package in Annexure VI, covering 14 packages and 46 distinct procedures.
legacyRecords.Is day-care chemotherapy covered?: PM-JAY explicitly covers day care treatments that do not require 24 hours of hospitalisation
legacyRecords.Pre/post-hospitalization days officially: Up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses, including medicines and diagnostics.
legacyRecords.What is official exclusion list (OPD, co:
Outpatient consultations and general OPD care are excluded, as the scheme covers inpatient hospitalisations and day-care procedures.

Cosmetic or aesthetic procedures.

Substance abuse and drug addiction rehabilitation services.

Infertility treatments and assisted reproductive procedures.

General assistance for organ transplants outside of the specific organ/tissue transplant packages explicitly included in the1,929 approved procedures.

Preventive health check-ups and routine screening tests.

Medical treatment provided at home rather than in a hospital.

sourceVerifications.Important correction / uncertainty: Do not treat every cancer procedure as automatically covered; latest package master and hospital empanelment must be checked.
sourceVerifications.Verification status: Partially verified — scheme basics confirmed; exact current oncology package details need latest HBP master.

applicationSteps.Programme: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Who Does It: Patient/family or assisted operator
applicationSteps.What to Do: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or use the official PM-JAY app/14555. Search using mobile/Aadhaar or other permitted identifiers and confirm the beneficiary/family record.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: Eligibility result or clear confirmation from PM-JAY helpdesk.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: If no record appears, ask the State Health Agency / district PM-JAY office to check state-specific beneficiary databases and correction route.

applicationSteps.Programme: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Who Does It: Patient or authorised operator at CSC / PM-JAY hospital
applicationSteps.What to Do: Complete the e-KYC/identity and family verification requested by the portal or Ayushman Mitra. Follow the state-approved identity alternatives if Aadhaar is unavailable.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: Verified beneficiary record; note any application/reference number.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: Do not assume a submitted e-KYC is an approved card. Follow up until the record is approved.

applicationSteps.Programme: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Who Does It: Patient/family or CSC / Ayushman Mitra
applicationSteps.What to Do: After approval, download/print the Ayushman card from the official beneficiary portal or request help at a CSC / empanelled hospital.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: Ayushman card / beneficiary ID.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: If details are wrong, request correction through the official beneficiary/state route before planned admission.

applicationSteps.Programme: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Who Does It: Patient with hospital social worker / Ayushman Mitra
applicationSteps.What to Do: Search the official empanelled-hospital directory by state, district and specialty. Call the hospital to confirm oncology service and PM-JAY acceptance for the required treatment.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: Hospital name, oncology department and confirmation of current empanelment/package availability.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: A hospital listing alone does not guarantee a particular oncology package is available there.

applicationSteps.Programme: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Step / Action: Obtain oncology assessment and treatment plan
applicationSteps.Who Does It: Treating oncologist and hospital PMAM / MEDCO
applicationSteps.What to Do: Submit diagnosis, staging, pathology, imaging and proposed treatment plan. Ask the hospital to map the case to the appropriate oncology package(s).
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: Signed treatment plan, package details and estimate / admission advice.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: Ask the hospital to explain any non-covered items before treatment.

applicationSteps.Programme: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Who Does It: Hospital PMAM / MEDCO and treating oncologist
applicationSteps.What to Do: The hospital submits the cancer treatment plan and required clinical records through the PM-JAY transaction system. Cancer care has a treatment-plan approval and staged pre-authorisation process.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: Pre-authorisation request ID and approval/queries.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: Do not start a planned package assuming approval. Ask the hospital to resolve queries or escalate to the State Health Agency.

applicationSteps.Programme: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Step / Action: Receive approved cashless treatment and retain records
applicationSteps.Who Does It: Hospital; patient/attendant checks records
applicationSteps.What to Do: Proceed with the approved package at the empanelled hospital. At discharge, collect discharge summary, treatment records and details of approved package / any patient-payable items.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: Discharge summary, prescriptions, test reports and grievance/transaction reference if needed.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: If treatment is denied or an unexplained charge is demanded, contact 14555 and the State Health Agency grievance channel.

journeySummary.Programme: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
journeySummary.Programme Type: शासकीय कॅशलेस आरोग्य हमी (रोख अनुदान नव्हे)
journeySummary.Who May Apply / Eligibility Snapshot: सर्वप्रथम लाभार्थ्याची पात्रता तपासा. पात्रता डेटाबेस/राज्याच्या नियमांवर आधारित आहे; ७०+ वर्षे वयाच्या लोकांसाठी एक वेगळा विस्तारित मार्ग आहे. कर्करोगावरील उपचार हे पॅकेज आणि पूर्व-परवानगीवर अवलंबून असतात.
journeySummary.Documents to Prepare: आधार किंवा इतर स्वीकृत सरकारी ओळखपत्र; रेशन/कुटुंब ओळखपत्र किंवा राज्य-मान्यताप्राप्त कौटुंबिक पुरावा; आयुष्मान कार्ड (जर आधीच तयार केले असेल तर); निदान, बायोप्सी/पॅथॉलॉजी, उपचार योजना आणि रुग्णालयातील नोंदी.
journeySummary.Contact / Submission Point: १४५५५ / १८००-१११-५६५; रुग्णालय आयुष्मान मित्र / पीएमएएम डेस्क; राज्य आरोग्य एजन्सी हेल्पलाइन.
journeySummary.Important Caveat: कर्करोग पॅकेजेससाठी क्लिनिकल उपचार-योजनेची मंजुरी आणि पूर्व-परवानगी आवश्यक आहे; कर्करोग पॅकेजेससाठी पूर्व-परवानगी अनिवार्य आहे. अचूक पॅकेज, प्रदात्याची पॅनेलवरील नोंदणी आणि उपलब्ध कव्हर तपासा. प्रत्येक कर्करोग सेवेचा आपोआप समावेश होत नाही.

applicationSteps.Programme: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Who Does It: रुग्ण/कुटुंब किंवा सहाय्यक ऑपरेटर
applicationSteps.What to Do: beneficiary.nha.gov.in उघडा किंवा अधिकृत PM-JAY ॲप/14555 वापरा. मोबाईल/आधार किंवा इतर अनुमत ओळखपत्रांचा वापर करून शोधा आणि लाभार्थी/कुटुंबाच्या नोंदीची पुष्टी करा.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: पात्रतेचा निकाल किंवा पीएम-जेएवाय हेल्पडेस्ककडून स्पष्ट पुष्टी.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: कोणतीही नोंद आढळत नसल्यास, राज्य आरोग्य एजन्सी / जिल्हा पीएम-जेएवाय कार्यालयाला राज्य-विशिष्ट लाभार्थी डेटाबेस आणि दुरुस्ती मार्ग तपासण्यास सांगा.

applicationSteps.Programme: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Who Does It: सीएससी / पीएम-जेएवाय रुग्णालयातील रुग्ण किंवा अधिकृत ऑपरेटर
applicationSteps.What to Do: पोर्टल किंवा आयुष्मान मित्राने विनंती केल्यानुसार ई-केवायसी/ओळख आणि कौटुंबिक पडताळणी पूर्ण करा. आधार उपलब्ध नसल्यास, राज्य-मान्यताप्राप्त पर्यायी ओळखपत्रांचा वापर करा.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: सत्यापित लाभार्थी नोंद; कोणताही अर्ज/संदर्भ क्रमांक नोंदवा.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: सादर केलेले ई-केवायसी म्हणजे मंजूर कार्ड आहे असे गृहीत धरू नका. नोंद मंजूर होईपर्यंत पाठपुरावा करा.

applicationSteps.Programme: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Step / Action: आयुष्मान कार्ड तयार करा किंवा मिळवा
applicationSteps.Who Does It: रुग्ण/कुटुंब किंवा सीएससी / आयुष्मान मित्र
applicationSteps.What to Do: मंजुरी मिळाल्यानंतर, अधिकृत लाभार्थी पोर्टलवरून आयुष्मान कार्ड डाउनलोड/प्रिंट करा किंवा सीएससी / सूचीबद्ध रुग्णालयात मदतीसाठी विनंती करा.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: आयुष्मान कार्ड / लाभार्थी ओळखपत्र.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: तपशील चुकीचा असल्यास, नियोजित प्रवेशापूर्वी अधिकृत लाभार्थी/राज्य मार्गाने दुरुस्तीची विनंती करा.

applicationSteps.Programme: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Who Does It: रुग्ण आणि रुग्णालयातील सामाजिक कार्यकर्ता / आयुष्मान मित्र
applicationSteps.What to Do: राज्य, जिल्हा आणि विशेषज्ञतेनुसार अधिकृत सूचीबद्ध रुग्णालयांच्या निर्देशिकेत शोधा. आवश्यक उपचारांसाठी ऑन्कोलॉजी सेवा आणि पीएम-जेएवाय स्वीकृतीची खात्री करण्यासाठी रुग्णालयाला फोन करा.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: रुग्णालयाचे नाव, ऑन्कोलॉजी विभाग आणि सध्याच्या पॅनेलवरील समावेश/पॅकेजच्या उपलब्धतेची पुष्टी.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: केवळ रुग्णालयाच्या यादीवरून तिथे एखादे विशिष्ट कर्करोग उपचार पॅकेज उपलब्ध असेलच याची खात्री नसते.

applicationSteps.Programme: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Step / Action: कर्करोग मूल्यांकन आणि उपचार योजना मिळवा
applicationSteps.Who Does It: उपचार करणारे ऑन्कोलॉजिस्ट आणि रुग्णालय PMAM / MEDCO
applicationSteps.What to Do: निदान, टप्प्यांचे वर्गीकरण, पॅथॉलॉजी, इमेजिंग आणि प्रस्तावित उपचार योजना सादर करा. रुग्णालयाला हे प्रकरण योग्य ऑन्कोलॉजी पॅकेजशी जोडण्यास सांगा.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: स्वाक्षरी केलेला उपचार आराखडा, पॅकेजचा तपशील आणि अंदाजपत्रक / प्रवेशासंबंधी सूचना.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: उपचार सुरू करण्यापूर्वी, विमा संरक्षण नसलेल्या बाबींबद्दल रुग्णालयाकडून माहिती घ्या.

applicationSteps.Programme: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Who Does It: रुग्णालय PMAM / MEDCO आणि उपचार करणारे ऑन्कोलॉजिस्ट
applicationSteps.What to Do: रुग्णालय पीएम-जेएवाय व्यवहार प्रणालीद्वारे कर्करोग उपचार योजना आणि आवश्यक वैद्यकीय नोंदी सादर करते. कर्करोग उपचारांमध्ये उपचार-योजना मंजुरी आणि टप्प्याटप्प्याने पूर्व-मंजुरी प्रक्रिया असते.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: पूर्व-अधिकृतता विनंती आयडी आणि मंजुरी/शंका.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: नियोजित पॅकेज मंजूर झाले आहे असे गृहीत धरून सुरू करू नका. शंकांचे निरसन करण्यासाठी रुग्णालयाला विचारा किंवा हे प्रकरण राज्य आरोग्य संस्थेकडे सोपवा.

applicationSteps.Programme: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
applicationSteps.Step / Action: मान्यताप्राप्त कॅशलेस उपचार मिळवा आणि नोंदी जपून ठेवा.
applicationSteps.Who Does It: रुग्णालय; रुग्ण/परिचारक नोंदी तपासत आहे
applicationSteps.What to Do: सूचीबद्ध रुग्णालयात मंजूर पॅकेजनुसार उपचार सुरू ठेवा. डिस्चार्जच्या वेळी, डिस्चार्ज सारांश, उपचारांच्या नोंदी आणि मंजूर पॅकेजचा तपशील / रुग्णाला देय असलेल्या कोणत्याही बाबींची माहिती घ्या.
applicationSteps.Evidence / Output to Keep: डिस्चार्ज सारांश, औषधचिठ्ठी, चाचणी अहवाल आणि आवश्यक असल्यास तक्रार/व्यवहार संदर्भ.
applicationSteps.If This Step Gets Stuck: उपचार नाकारल्यास किंवा अकारण शुल्क आकारल्यास, 14555 आणि राज्य आरोग्य संस्थेच्या तक्रार निवारण प्रणालीशी संपर्क साधा.

legacyRecords.Name of the insurance: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधान मंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PMJAY)
legacyRecords.Eligibility: ग्रामीण कुटुंबे: SECC-2011 च्या आकडेवारीवर आधारित; यामध्ये वंचित कुटुंबे (उदा., एक खोलीची कच्ची घरे, १६-५९ वयोगटातील प्रौढ व्यक्ती नसणे, अनुसूचित जाती/जमाती, भूमिहीन रोजंदारी मजूर) आणि आपोआप समाविष्ट झालेले गट (बेघर, निराश्रित, हाताने मैला साफ करणारे) यांचा समावेश आहे. शहरी कुटुंबे: यामध्ये ११ अनौपचारिक कामगार श्रेणींचा समावेश आहे (उदा., कचरा वेचणारे, घरगुती कामगार, रस्त्यावरील विक्रेते, बांधकाम कामगार, चालक, स्वच्छता कामगार). ज्येष्ठ नागरिक (वय ७०+): उत्पन्नाची पर्वा न करता सार्वत्रिक व्याप्ती, ज्यामध्ये ₹५ लाखांचे संरक्षण दिले जाते (विद्यमान PM-JAY कुटुंबांसाठी टॉप-अप किंवा इतरांसाठी नवीन संरक्षण).
legacyRecords.Cancer types covered: त्याच्या मानक ऑन्कोलॉजी पॅकेजेस अंतर्गत केमोथेरपी आणि सर्जिकल ऑन्कोलॉजीसह कर्करोग उपचारांचा समावेश आहे. विशिष्ट कर्करोगांचा तपशील दिलेला नाही. आरोग्य लाभ पॅकेज २.१ अंतर्गत, ऑन्कोलॉजी उपचार तीन समर्पित विशेषज्ञांमध्ये विभागलेले आहेत, ज्यात १६६ पॅकेजेस आणि ४३५ प्रक्रियांचा समावेश आहे: १. मेडिकल ऑन्कोलॉजी - विशेषज्ञता कोड - 'MO' ७२ पॅकेजेस ज्यात २६४ प्रक्रियांचा समावेश आहे. यात केमोथेरपी सायकल, वैद्यकीय व्यवस्थापन आणि डे-केअर प्रक्रियांचा समावेश आहे. २. रेडिएशन ऑन्कोलॉजी - विशेषज्ञता कोड: 'MR' १४ पॅकेजेस ज्यात ४६ प्रक्रियांचा समावेश आहे. यात रेडिओथेरपी उपचार आणि रेडिएशन डिलिव्हरी पॅकेजेसचा समावेश आहे. ३. सर्जिकल ऑन्कोलॉजी - विशेषज्ञता कोड - 'SC' ८० पॅकेजेस ज्यात १२५ प्रक्रियांचा समावेश आहे. यात शस्त्रक्रिया प्रक्रिया आणि ट्यूमर रिसेक्शनचा समावेश आहे.
legacyRecords.Benefit cover: पात्र कुटुंबांना देशभरातील सूचीबद्ध सार्वजनिक आणि खाजगी रुग्णालयांमधील द्वितीय आणि तृतीय स्तरावरील आंतररुग्ण खर्चासाठी प्रति वर्ष ₹५ लाखांचे कॅशलेस आणि पेपरलेस संरक्षण मिळते. या लाभात आयसीयू केअर, शस्त्रक्रिया, निदान आणि औषधोपचार यांसारख्या २७ विशेष क्षेत्रांमधील अंदाजे १,९२९ वैद्यकीय प्रक्रियांचा समावेश आहे. यामध्ये पहिल्या दिवसापासून पूर्व-अस्तित्वात असलेल्या आजारांचा समावेश होतो, तसेच रुग्णालयात दाखल होण्यापूर्वीचे ३ दिवस आणि रुग्णालयातून बाहेर पडल्यानंतरचे १५ दिवसांचे उपचारही समाविष्ट आहेत. याव्यतिरिक्त, ७० वर्षे आणि त्याहून अधिक वयाच्या सर्व ज्येष्ठ नागरिकांना ₹५ लाखांचे विशेष वार्षिक संरक्षण मिळते (विद्यमान पीएम-जेएवाय कुटुंबांसाठी विशेष टॉप-अप म्हणून किंवा इतरांसाठी नवीन संरक्षण म्हणून), तर बाह्यरुग्ण सेवा (ओपीडी), कॉस्मेटिक शस्त्रक्रिया आणि व्यसनमुक्ती यातून वगळण्यात आले आहे.
legacyRecords.Location/State covered: ही योजना संपूर्ण भारतभर कार्यरत असून, देशभरातील सूचीबद्ध सार्वजनिक आणि खाजगी रुग्णालयांमध्ये आरोग्य सेवा पुरवते. देशव्यापी पोर्टेबिलिटीमुळे, पात्र लाभार्थी त्यांच्या मूळ राज्याची पर्वा न करता, कोणत्याही सूचीबद्ध रुग्णालयात कॅशलेस उपचार घेऊ शकतात. सूचीबद्ध रुग्णालयांमध्ये भारतातील सर्व सरकारी रुग्णालये तसेच निवडक खाजगी रुग्णालयांचा समावेश आहे.
legacyRecords.Exceptions: प्रमुख अपवाद: स्वतःचे २/३/४ चाकी वाहन असणे, शासकीय नोकरी, ₹१०,००० पेक्षा जास्त मासिक उत्पन्न, ५ एकरपेक्षा जास्त जमीन असणे, किंवा स्वतःचे पक्के घर असणे.
legacyRecords.Is radiation oncology covered?: रेडिएशन ऑन्कोलॉजी हे परिशिष्ट VI मध्ये आरोग्य लाभ पॅकेज अंतर्गत एक अधिकृत स्पेशालिटी (स्पेशालिटी कोड: MR) म्हणून सूचीबद्ध आहे, ज्यामध्ये 14 पॅकेजेस आणि 46 वेगवेगळ्या प्रक्रियांचा समावेश आहे.
legacyRecords.Is day-care chemotherapy covered?: पीएम-जेएवाय योजनेत अशा डे केअर उपचारांचा स्पष्टपणे समावेश आहे, ज्यासाठी २४ तास रुग्णालयात दाखल राहण्याची आवश्यकता नसते.
legacyRecords.Pre/post-hospitalization days officially: रुग्णालयात दाखल होण्यापूर्वीच्या ३ दिवसांपर्यंतचा आणि रुग्णालयातून परतल्यानंतरच्या १५ दिवसांपर्यंतचा खर्च, ज्यामध्ये औषधे आणि निदान चाचण्यांचा समावेश आहे.
legacyRecords.What is official exclusion list (OPD, co: बाह्यरुग्ण सल्ला आणि सामान्य बाह्यरुग्ण सेवा वगळण्यात आल्या आहेत, कारण या योजनेत आंतररुग्ण रुग्णालयातील उपचार आणि डे-केअर प्रक्रियांचा समावेश आहे. कॉस्मेटिक किंवा सौंदर्यविषयक प्रक्रिया. मादक पदार्थांचे सेवन आणि मादक पदार्थांच्या व्यसनामुक्तीसाठी पुनर्वसन सेवा. वंध्यत्व उपचार आणि सहाय्यक प्रजनन प्रक्रिया. १,९२९ मंजूर प्रक्रियांमध्ये स्पष्टपणे समाविष्ट असलेल्या विशिष्ट अवयव/ऊतक प्रत्यारोपण पॅकेजेस व्यतिरिक्त अवयव प्रत्यारोपणासाठी सामान्य सहाय्य. प्रतिबंधात्मक आरोग्य तपासणी आणि नियमित तपासणी चाचण्या. रुग्णालयाऐवजी घरी दिले जाणारे वैद्यकीय उपचार.

sourceVerifications.Key facts confirmed from official source: पात्र कुटुंबासाठी प्रति वर्ष ₹५ लाख; एनएचए लाभार्थ्यांच्या साहित्यात डे-केअर उपचार आणि रुग्णालयात दाखल होण्यापूर्वी ३ दिवस व नंतर १५ दिवसांचे उपचार समाविष्ट आहेत; कर्करोगासाठी पॅकेज/पूर्वपरवानगी नियमांनुसार तरतूद आहे.
sourceVerifications.Important correction / uncertainty: कर्करोगावरील प्रत्येक उपचार आपोआप समाविष्ट आहे असे समजू नका; नवीनतम पॅकेज मास्टर आणि रुग्णालयाची पॅनेलवरील नोंदणी तपासली पाहिजे.
